verdict.rationale: Gemini in Firebase provides a natural-language chat interface in the Firebase console that answers questions, generates code, and shortens troubleshooting (firebase-docs-21, firebase-docs-13). It also gives AI-driven crash analysis with root causes and suggested fixes via Crashlytics (firebase-docs-14, firebase-docs-25). missing for 10: explicit evidence of writing database queries, of explaining the user's own backend configuration rather than general product questions, of debugging backend/server-side errors (crash support covers Apple/Android apps), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
